# 74461 - 8-bit counter with 3-state outputs

Package DIP-24 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74461.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74461.json)

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 2 | I0 | input |  |  | function select, with I1 |
| 3 | D0 | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | D1 | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | D2 | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | D3 | input |  |  |  |

| 12 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 13 | OE | enable | low |  | controls pins 22, 21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 16, 15; when not enabled: float; output enable for Q0-Q7; high = high impedance; the counter keeps working |
| 14 | CO | output |  | totem-pole | carry out: low when Q7-Q0 are all high (and CI is low); otherwise high |
| 15 | Q7 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |
| 16 | Q6 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |

| 18 | Q4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |

| 20 | Q2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |
| 21 | Q1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |
| 22 | Q0 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |
| 23 | CI | input | low |  | carry in: low lets INCREMENT count; high turns INCREMENT into HOLD |
| 24 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 22 | Q0 = OE' ? FF0 : Z | Shows counter bit 0 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 21 | Q1 = OE' ? FF1 : Z | Shows counter bit 1 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 20 | Q2 = OE' ? FF2 : Z | Shows counter bit 2 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 19 | Q3 = OE' ? FF3 : Z | Shows counter bit 3 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 18 | Q4 = OE' ? FF4 : Z | Shows counter bit 4 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 17 | Q5 = OE' ? FF5 : Z | Shows counter bit 5 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 16 | Q6 = OE' ? FF6 : Z | Shows counter bit 6 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 15 | Q7 = OE' ? FF7 : Z | Shows counter bit 7 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high. |
| 14 | CO = NOT(CI' AND FF0 AND FF1 AND FF2 AND FF3 AND FF4 AND FF5 AND FF6 AND FF7) | carry out: low when Q7-Q0 are all high (and CI is low); otherwise high |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: rising edge of CK

- I1 low, I0 low: CLEAR, all bits = 0
- I1 low, I0 high: HOLD
- I1 high, I0 low: LOAD, Q = D7-D0
- I1 high, I0 high, CI low: INCREMENT (count up by one)
- I1 high, I0 high, CI high: HOLD
- OE does not affect counting

| Value | Figure |

## Propagation delays

All measured at commercial, VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-75 C, CL 50 pF, R1 200 ohm, R2 390 ohm (test load).

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CI | CO | PLH | 35 | 50 |
| CI | CO | PHL | 35 | 50 |
| CK | any Q | PLH | 20 | 30 |
| CK | any Q | PHL | 20 | 30 |
| CK | CO | PLH | 55 | 80 |
| CK | CO | PHL | 55 | 80 |
| OE | any Q | PZX | 35 | 45 |
| OE | any Q | PXZ | 35 | 45 |

## Not known

- CO and CI: the description says CO is low when Q7-Q0 are all high, without naming CI; the switching table gives a CI-to-CO delay, so CI is taken to take part (CO low only while CI is also low). Whether I0/I1 affect CO is not stated.
- Output type of CO: the description says only the data outputs (Q) are three-state; the logic diagram shows CO's buffer with no OE line. totem-pole is taken from that, not stated.
- The book gives one delay per path, not split into PLH and PHL; both edges carry the same figure here.

## Notes

Military figures (book page 6-6): fmax 10.5 MHz, CI-CO 35/60, CK-Q 20/35, CK-CO 55/95, enable/disable 35/55 ns typ/max; setup 60 ns, clock width 40 ns low, 30 ns high. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS461.

## Sources

- [Monolithic Memories LSI Databook, 6th ed. (1985), section 6, SN54/74LS461 8-Bit Counter](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/mmi/_dataBooks/1985_MMI_LSI_Databook_6ed.pdf) - book pages 6-4, 6-5, 6-6 (PDF pages 247, 248, 249); SN74LS461
